FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Pawsitive Care Veterinary Services, we specialize in providing routine medical care, diagnostics, and minor surgical procedures primarily for companion animals. Our core operations include wellness exams, vaccinations, dental care, and minor surgical interventions, all performed by our licensed veterinarians and credentialed staff. We prioritize animal safety and health by ensuring that our facilities are secure, well-maintained, and adherent to all local animal welfare standards. We have established robust waste handling protocols to manage biohazard and sharps disposal effectively. Additionally, we do not offer boarding services as a primary business line, although we are equipped to provide limited, short-term boarding in compliance with local regulations. Our commitment to ethical practices is reflected in our clean regulatory history, marked by no unresolved licensing violations or major malpractice claims over the past five years. We are dedicated to maintaining high standards of veterinary care while minimizing operational risks to our clients and their beloved pets.

Our veterinary practice provides comprehensive animal care, including procedures for pets, despite occasionally facing regulatory inquiries that we address as part of our commitment to maintaining high standards of service.
